Versions

Every release of SuperUnicode, its database and its reports.

SuperUnicode 0.1.0 (2026-08-14)

The first release. Everything here is compiled, tested and attested with CRC32c + Fletcher-64:

  • Base SUCS — 31-bit space, hierarchy, three-space layout, SCP/Traps/Sentinel.
  • Machine-Instruction Database — the Public/ trees for Base and Extended with SUCD.zip / ExtSUCD.zip and per-component archives.
  • Plugin subsystem — stage → reboot → checksum gate → OWFS plugin partition → range registration, with quarantine.
  • Plugin SDK — template, hellocp example, plugin_pack and plugin_verify tools.
  • Reference implementations — SUTF8/16/32, extSUTF (vector/vsutf/esutf), SUCA and the one-TU unified header test.

Validation. The 0.1.0 suite runs 6 tests (framing, planes, plugin lifecycle, unified headers) — all passing on the reference build.
